## Description

**What**: Update existing documentation to reflect the new module structure and config keys: CLAUDE.md (architecture section, quick reference), CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md (soft_cap, file-size cap, grep-timeout config keys), docs/contracts/ci-review-context-request.md (created in S1, ensure cross-references resolve), and any reviewer agent docs that mention the loop.

**Why**: SC1 doc portion. Ensures future agents have accurate awareness of the loop architecture and config knobs.

**Scope**:
- IN: CLAUDE.md updates; CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md updates; ensure docs/contracts cross-references resolve; reviewer agent doc updates
- OUT: new documentation files beyond the contract document already created in S1

## Done Definitions

- When complete, CLAUDE.md architecture section describes the loop + caching + exhaustion handling ← Satisfies: SC1 (doc portion)
- When complete, CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md documents soft_cap (per-tier), file-size cap, grep-timeout, and the context-request contract version key ← Satisfies: SC1 (doc portion)

## Considerations

- [Maintainability] Follow .claude/docs/DOCUMENTATION-GUIDE.md for formatting and structure

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: Update project docs to reflect the context-augmentation loop, caching, and exhaustion handling
